en.headline: Symphony of Lights stages final show over Victoria Harbour
en.dek: The 22-year-old nightly spectacle ended Wednesday at 8pm with rooftop pyrotechnics as WinterFest launched with new district light shows.
body: A Symphony of Lights concluded its run on Wednesday night after 22 years of nightly performances across Victoria Harbour. The 10-minute finale began at 8pm, with lights and music synchronised across more than 40 buildings on both sides of the harbour, including Central Plaza, the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, and the International Finance Centre towers. Fireworks launched from several rooftops drew audible gasps from the crowd.

Thousands of residents and tourists gathered along the Tsim Sha Tsui promenade, with some arriving as early as 6pm or 7pm to secure viewing spots. Tourism minister Rosanna Law said the added pyrotechnic elements provided a fitting close. She recalled that in 2005 the show was recognised by Guinness World Records as the world's largest permanent light and sound show.

Law spoke at the launch of Hong Kong WinterFest 2026, which runs through Christmas and the New Year. As part of the festival, light projections will appear on building facades in Central and Tsim Sha Tsui from 7pm to 11pm each night. Officials have said the long-running harbour show will give way to seasonal light events in different districts.

zh.headline: 幻彩詠香江最後一場潙演添煙火告別維港
zh.dek: 有二十二年歷史的潙演周三晚上八時上演最後一場，加入屋頂煙火，維多利亞港兩岸超過四十棟大廈配合演出，同時繁紛冬日巡禮啟動。
body: 「幻彩詠香江」周三晚上八時上演最後一場潙演，結束二十二年的夜間潙演。維多利亞港兩岸超過四十棟大廈，包括中環廣場、會展及兩座國際金融中心，配合音樂亮起燈光，潙演歷時約十分鐘。部分大廈屋頂更發放煙火，現場觀眾發出讚嘆。
尖沙咀海傍集結數以千市民及遊客，部分人早於下午六時或七時已到場佔位。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，加入煙火元素令潙演有完美結束。她提到，二零零五年「幻彩詠香江」獲吉尼斯世界紀錄認為全球最大永久性燈光音樂潙演。
羅淑佩是在香港繁紛冬日巡禮二零二六啟動儀式上發言。巡禮由聖誕節至新年，期間中環及尖沙咀的標誌性大廈外牆將於晚上七時至十一時投射光影表演。當局指出，長期的維港夜間潙演將由不同地區的季節性光影項目取代。
